scope: Engineering repair before V2 modeling. Eight TRAIN structures used for representation checks. All 5,773 target-free geometries used only for feature precomputation. No target-bearing CSV or historical test results opened.

descriptor_design.normalization: Every positive occupancy sum is used directly, with no lower bound clamp.
descriptor_design.direction: Q = sum(w * u u^T) / sum(w), u = displacement / actual positive edge distance; anisotropy = (3 tr(Q^2) - 1)/2, clipped only for floating error to [0,1]. Isotropic 0, collinear 1.
descriptor_design.undefined_moments: A moment with zero valid weight is null; coordination and bond counts can be zero. Missing radius propagates null through bond ratio; no unknown-species renormalization.
descriptor_design.feature_count: 12 retains invariant anisotropy; 11 drops only that column.

selection_rule: First four ordered and first four disordered TRAIN material IDs ascending, n_sites <= 50; no label selection.
